candidate_program.name: global_continuation_uncertainty
candidate_program.rationale: Adds greedy continuation value and penalizes the cover-versus-greedy gap per surviving vertex, favoring more tightly estimated continuations. Both algorithms reach the full root-conditioned residual; their CPU cost can be substantial and the gap supplies only a ranking cue.
candidate_program.rule: weight + residual_greedy_weight - 0.4 * max(0, residual_cover_weight - residual_greedy_weight) / (1 + max(0, remaining_count - degree - 1))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
